en:
Nyahahaha! Thanks for inviting me, Kaede!
So you, too, felt our destinies intertwine!
Our destinies? That's going a bit too far.

Huhhh? How so? I can't help feeling so
fascinated by you, Kaede.

<CLT=cltMIND>Hearing Angie say that makes me worry she'll
sacrifice me in some way.

Hm, hm? Can you hear Atua's voice, Kaede?
Does He divinely inspire you, too?
Huh? Atua's voice?

As I've said, when I sculpt sculptures or paint
paintings, my body becomes Atua's vessel.

He fills me with His divine inspiration.
Ohhhhhhhhh!

And then, through me, He immaculately
conceives all the art my body creates.

So when you play the piano, you're feeling
Atua's divine inspiration too, right?
No, not at all...

Oh? Really? Then how do you play the
piano?
Hey, how do you do it?
How do you do it without Atua?

I don't do anything too special. I just read
the score in front of me and play.

Of course, I'm not *just* playing the score.
I also interpret the piece in my own way.
Your way? Not Atua's?
Yeah, *my* interpretation.

Hmm... Hmmm... So what you're saying is, you
just haven't been introduced to Atua, right?

I don't need to be introduced.
I can live without Atua.
Hmmm... Be careful what you say, Kaede...

Otherwise, you will be punished over your
next three lifetimes!

But you still have time to act now!
You just need to believe in Atua.
<CLT=cltMIND>This sounds like an infomercial...

Atua has spoken... You will earn two points
if you meet Atua right now!
<CLT=cltMIND>It's definitely like an infomercial!

You wanna meet Him, right Kaede? If you do,
you'll probably make much prettier music.
I can manage on my own
I'm good for now
I'll find faith on my own
Are you unsure of something?
<CLT=cltMIND>Um...what should I say?
I can manage on my own.

On your own? It would be much faster to
ask Atua.

But if it's not something I do on my own, I
can't be proud of my own performance.

I want to enjoy music and deliver that
feeling to everyone by myself.
I'm good for now.

Mm-hm, mm-hm... Well, if you're satisfied
then I guess that's that.

But I also think it's weird to ask Atua for
help.

There'd be no point in playing if it's not my
own performance.
I'll find faith on my own.

Nyahahaha! You're so funny, Kaede.
There's no need to look anywhere else.

Atua is the one true god. There are no
other gods before Him.
<CLT=cltMIND>Angie is...s-sorta scaring me right now...

You might think there are other gods cuz Atua
can change His form to suit people's needs.
That is one convenient god...

A-Anyway, I don't need a god right now!
I'll perform music my own way.

Hmmm... So you have no desire to accept
Atua into your heart. How unfortunate.

But if you change your mind, let me know!
Atua and I will be waiting for you, Kaede!

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Angie's <CLT=cltSTRONG>Report Card<CLT=cltSYSTEM> has been updated
based on your experience with her.

<CLT=cltMIND>After parting ways with Angie, I returned
to my room.
